# ADR-3061: A06: Dependency allow-list configuration for runtime 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unvetted packages introduce known CVEs.

## Decision

Build systems SHALL maintain a dependency allow-list configuration for runtime 1 (A06-1).

## Consequences

Allow-list updates require security review.
